# Motherland CRM Solutions

> Motherland CRM (also known as Motherlands CRM / Motherland CRM Solutions) is a real-time CRM software platform for sales teams.

## Product
- Lead management CRM with custom statuses and pipelines
- Excel & CSV lead import / export
- Team roles: Administrators, Sub Admins, and Agents
- Real-time collaboration (comments, assignments, status updates)
- Reminders, softphone calling (Zoiper / MicroSIP), smart filters
- Drag-and-drop column layouts, branding, crypto billing (USDT)
